case_number: Civil Appeal No 6805 of 2022 and Civil Appeal No 6806 of 2022
summary: Validity of OAT abolition; maintainability of writ petitions; Article 323-A does not preclude Union from abolishing SATs; General Clauses Act Section 21 applicable to tribunal establishment; August 2, 2019 notification upheld; no violation of Article 14 or natural justice; Union not functus officio after establishing OAT; abolition does not violate access to justice; State cannot claim relief by taking advantage of its own wrong.
legal_provisions_cited: L. Chandra Kumar v. Union of India (1997)
final_judgment: Notification dated August 2, 2029 upholding abolition of Orissa Administrative Tribunal upheld; writ petitions dismissed.
